The FloPlast 110mm black uPVC double socket pipe coupler provides a robust solution for connecting soil and vent drainage pipes. This push-fit pipe fitting is manufactured from uPVC, ensuring strength and long-lasting durability for demanding plumbing installations. Its design allows for easy installation in various scenarios, including where high temperature discharges may be present. For optimal jointing, applying a silicone lubricant to the ring seal joints is recommended, facilitating a secure and reliable connection in all drainage applications.
